findings.title: Actual KDM6-entry orphan ice number
findings.trigger: QI=0 and NI>0 at actual KDM6 entry, first at (i,call_lat_index,k)=(104,2,1).
findings.impact: Strict species preflight rejects before PSD/process; no post-call state or water/energy evidence. Upstream cause is outside Team 02 scope.

findings.title: Cloud freezing can move Q without transferring N
findings.trigger: Supercooled QC>qmin, positive pfrzdtc, NC<=ncmin, and surviving QI>qmin.
findings.impact: Creates ice mass with NI unchanged; local species validation can terminate the call. No targeted dynamic reproduction in this audit.

findings.title: Rain freezing uses graupel density 1000 outside PSD support
findings.trigger: Positive pfrzdtr writes QG+=E and BG+=E/denr with denr=1000 kg m^-3; pair survives qcrmin cleanup.
findings.impact: QG/BG=1000 kg m^-3 exceeds selected ProgB 100–900 domain and can produce unsupported PSD/fatal. Earlier matched observer is historical and is not PR77's actual fatal.

findings.title: Mass cutoff cleanup has no compensating water/heat transfer
findings.impact: Zeros condensate and associated descriptors with no vapor/other-phase or temperature update; per-cell loss is bounded by cutoff but aggregate conservation impact is unmeasured.

findings.title: Cold process trial guard is not whole-call rollback atomicity
findings.trigger: Trial endpoint is accepted then state is applied in place; post-write endpoint error stop or later process fatal.
findings.impact: No snapshot restoration or recoverable status; fatal stops model and no post-call outputs are produced. In-memory earlier column/precipitation effects are not proven serialized.
